witness_description: No counterexample is certified. The bounded indexing audit found no representation failure, but membership in the undefined family \mathcal A cannot be tested.
refutation_explanation: The quote does not define \mathcal A, the ambient ground set, the admissible cyclic orders, or the quantified range of r. Consequently, a finite search cannot decide the asserted membership conclusion. The program only verifies the representation statement under its explicitly declared finite indexing convention.
search_space: Illustrative audit only: for each integer r from 1 through 4, all 29 r-subsets of {a_0,...,a_{2r-1}} containing a_r and excluding a_0 were checked against every order representative fixing a_0 at position 0 and a_r at position r. This sweeps 14,549 exact (set, order) pairs; it is not an exhaustive search of the source claim.
